Il pneumotorace è una complicanza dell'A:
Pneumothorax is a complication of COVID-19 ARDS (alveolar damage, positive-pressure ventilation). On a bedside X-ray the classic sign is the visceral pleural line with air devoid of lung markings beyond it; with the patient supine, air collects anteriorly and inferiorly: a deep, hyperlucent costophrenic sulcus (deep sulcus sign), heart and diaphragm borders that are too sharp.
Signs of tension: shift of the mediastinum to the opposite side, flattening or inversion of the hemidiaphragm, widening of the intercostal spaces. Pneumothorax in a ventilated patient is a critical finding: it is communicated immediately, verbally.
Differential diagnosis: skin fold (extends beyond the lung, markings continue), scapular border, emphysematous bulla.
